## (c) DLEQ fail-closed
- blinded.rs (mint/swap): `(None, Require)=>Err` preserved; mint_pk bound to keyset via build_pubkey_map + upstream `sig.id != keyset.id` check. Sound. ✓
- **nutzap RECEIVE path**: on master (where #2964 is branched) `verify_nutzap_dleq` STILL has the two `continue` fail-opens (absent dleq / absent r). #2964 does NOT touch them — it only changes the `verify_dleq` call args. So #2964 *alone* does not close the receive-path fail-open. **#2959 is what fixes it** (turns both continues into hard errors). After #2964 rebases onto #2959, fail-closed is preserved because #2964 only edits the call ARGS, not the surrounding error structure. Net ≥ #2959. Good — but see rebase risk.
